chunks: Sahl ibn Ziyād, from Ibn Abī Naṣr, from ʿĀṣim ibn Ḥumayd, from Abū Baṣīr, from Abū ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام, who said:
Regarding a man who accuses a young girl of unchastity: should he be flogged? He said: “No, not until she reaches puberty.”

key_terms.الصَّبِيَّةَ: a young girl who has not yet reached maturity
key_terms.تَبْلُغَ: she reaches puberty or legal maturity
key_terms.يَقْذِفُ: accuses falsely of illicit sexual conduct
key_terms.يُجْلَدُ: he is flogged; the hadd punishment is carried out

ai.seo_question: Is the hadd punishment applied for accusing a girl of unchastity before she reaches puberty?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling concerning the hadd of false accusation against a young girl. Imam Abū ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام states that the prescribed flogging is not carried out in such a case until she has reached puberty.
